mainEntity.name: Can a supercharged Range Rover V8 replace my Discovery 4 508PN?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not directly. Supercharged and naturally aspirated 5.0 V8 engines differ in components, ancillaries and calibration, so we check your VIN, engine code and market specification before recommending a compatible replacement.

mainEntity.name: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt 508PN engines compare?

acceptedAnswer.text: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing V8. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

mainEntity.name: Can I buy a Discovery 4 V8 engine supply only?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages and private customers with their own mechanic can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

mainEntity.name: What affects the Discovery 4 engine replacement cost for a 508PN?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any cooling or ancillary parts needed and the labour involved, including body lifting. Send your registration or VIN for a written quote.

mainEntity.name: Is there a warranty on a replacement 508PN engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

mainEntity.name: Do you deliver Land Rover V8 engines across the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

mainEntity.name: How long does a 508PN engine replacement usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed, any body-lift work and additional repairs found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed.
